data.name: Modern Mud
data.detailed_description:
There are worlds that live and die in the silence of a server, narrated through text and forged by the will of their players. Modern MUD is a return to that essence, a reimagining of the text-based RPG for an era that has forgotten the power of imagination.

This is not a game of radiant heroes or simple victories. It is a chronicle of survival in a grim world, a turn-based tactical RPG where every decision is permanent, and every shadow can conceal either a forgotten treasure or a premature death. Prepare for an adventure where only your intellect and cunning will keep you alive.

FORGE YOUR WILL IN AN UNFORGIVING WORLD

Immerse yourself in a deep and strategic role-playing experience that demands your full attention. In Modern MUD, there are no predefined paths or hands to guide your destiny. There is only a hostile, persistent world that reacts to your every action, where the consequences of your choices will echo through time, and other players can be your greatest allies or your deadliest foes.

CORE FEATURES

A WORLD DENSE WITH SECRETS Explore a realm designed to be deciphered. Its secrets are not revealed on a map; they are hidden in descriptions, whispered in dialogues, and protected by riddles and formidable enemies. Forge fragile alliances with factions of ambiguous morality, knowing that every favor granted can become a future betrayal.

UNRELENTING TACTICAL COMBAT Master a turn-based combat system where strategy is everything. Knowledge of your abilities and those of your enemy is the only weapon that matters. Overcome challenges that will test your mind, whether against the creatures lurking in the darkness or against other players in duels to the death.

PURPOSEFUL CHARACTER CREATION Define your origin among the versatile Humans, the brutal Orcs, or the enigmatic Elves. Specialize as a Warrior, Rogue, Mage, or Ranger. Every attribute point spent, every skill chosen, is a tactical decision that will define your ability to survive and thrive.

A PANTHEON OF INDIFFERENT GODS Pledge allegiance to a deity and walk the path of Order or Chaos. Your actions alter the cosmic balance, but do not expect clear guidance. Earning the favor of dark or divine powers is an arduous path that demands sacrifice, and the powers they grant always come at a price.

SOCIETY: ALLIANCE, TREACHERY, AND CONQUEST

CLAN WARFARE AND DOMINION True power is not achieved alone. Create or join a clan, forge a brotherhood under a common banner, and declare war on your rivals. Fight for control of territories, strategic resources, and reputation itself. Politics and diplomacy are as lethal as the sword.

UNRESTRICTED PVP Danger does not only emanate from dungeons. Face other players in combat where honor is optional and victory is everything. Test your skills, seize loot from your victims, and build a fearsome reputation. In Modern MUD, every encounter with another player is a crossroads of tension and opportunity.

TAVERNS AND SOCIAL HUBS Even in a dark world, refuges exist. Visit bustling taverns and other social centers to rest, recruit allies, gather crucial information, or simply engage in games of chance and skill. It is in these places that rumors are woven, alliances are born, and betrayals are planned.

data.short_description: Forge your destiny in a no-compromise text RPG. Explore a brutal world filled with challenging quests, hidden secrets and ruthless PvP. Every choice shapes your path in a realm of chaos and betrayal, where gods walk among mortals and watch your fall or your glory

  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
